subject: Re: Facility location benchmarks: 40x fewer recomputations, memory risk
body:
Team,

Decisions from Monday's review:

1. Benchmarks run on the 256GB hosts — sharding is a Q3 optimization, not a blocker.
2. The integration prototype consumes the fresh embeddings coming out of our 384-GPU vulcan week that started Jun 29; Emeka, target Jul 8 for the first end-to-end run against the production update stream so we hit the Jul 10 go/no-go.
3. Tereza's 40x recomputation result with beta 3 and lambda 0.1 goes in the go/no-go packet as the headline, alongside the stability numbers.

If the prototype holds up, Q3 adoption goes to Hana for sign-off the following week.

Anders
